recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, realistic portrait of a man whose face and head are partially obscured by a dense swarm of vibrant blue butterflies, set against a bright blue sky with soft white clouds and framed by a dark blue border containing top-aligned typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Butterflies act as a biological mask, obscuring identity while emphasizing the eyes.
The monochromatic blue of the insects contrasts with the warm skin tones of the subject.
The dark blue outer frame compresses the airy sky background, focusing attention on the central figure.
Symmetry in the face is disrupted by the organic, asymmetrical placement of the butterflies.
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from the subject
Flat, solid-color top border for text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, visible through gaps in the butterfly swarm.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves outward following the scattered butterflies into the sky, then upward to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides breathing room around the head, while the border provides a structural container.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and cobalt blue (butterflies and background).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues against muted, realistic values in the facial rendering.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blues, whites, and flesh tones

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Star symbol used as a separator between words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with color variation to distinguish words.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Modern Serif (e.g., Bodoni or Didot variants)
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp terminals of the original.
Captures the wide, formal, and authoritative feel of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist airbrushed painting of a man's face being covered by a swarm of blue butterflies. The background is a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. The man wears a white t-shirt. Leave a solid dark blue rectangular bar at the very top for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a high-contrast Modern Serif font in all-caps, center the text within the top dark blue bar. Use a light blue color for the text and insert a small star symbol between the primary words. Apply wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Are the butterflies a vibrant cobalt blue?
Is the text perfectly centered in the top bar?
Are the man's eyes clearly visible and expressive?
Is the transition between the sky and the top border a sharp line?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the skin tone highlights
mustRedesign: Avoid literal transcription of the original band or album names.
Ensure the star symbol is a generic graphic, not a specific logo.
postGenerationChecks: Verify the butterflies have realistic wing patterns.
Ensure the typography does not touch the edges of the frame.
Confirm the sky has a natural gradient from horizon to zenith.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Portrait + Biological Masking + High-Contrast Serif Header
